subject.title: feat(workboard): identify active cards in user-visible replies

question: Should Workboard card identifiers become a default user-visible reply prefix for applicable active-card sessions?
rationale: The patch adds a new visible reply convention and changes dashboard child-session routing semantics; correctness proof can establish behavior but cannot establish whether this is the desired permanent product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the visible marker
options.body: Keep the marker feature, subject to a clean rebase and real end-to-end evidence for routing, formatting, and unchanged unrelated replies.

options.title: Keep routing only
options.body: Land or request a narrower fix for parent-agent routing while omitting the new user-visible Workboard reply convention.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Hold the feature until Workboard product ownership defines the intended reply-format contract and opt-out behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the visible marker
recommendation.body: Keep the marker feature, subject to a clean rebase and real end-to-end evidence for routing, formatting, and unchanged unrelated replies.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence connects this contributor to the complete proposed routing and marker design, though current-main ownership could not be established from the supplied data.
